messages:
sam: starting orchestrated rollout now for feature flag `new-routing-v2` -> canary 5% (will expand to 25% if signals are green). goal: validate latency, error rate, and fallback correctness. kicking off at 1772101123. pls post any blockers.

devon: deployed canary image `route-gateway:canary-2026-03-17` to cluster, 6 pods healthy. no OOMs seen in initial warmup.

li: oncall here — i'll watch alerts and dashboards. post Grafana & SLO links and i'll pin.

mira: QA smoke passed on staging for the main prompt set (50 queries). found one flaky re-ranking case, investigating but not blocking canary.

sasha: traffic-split rule applied via traffic-controller. snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: route-gw-split
spec:
  backends:
  - service: route-gw-stable
    weight: 95
  - service: route-gw-canary
    weight: 5
```

sasha: feature flag toggled in LaunchDarkly: `new-routing-v2` = 5% (key: rdw_new_routing_v2)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout finished: all canary pods Ready=6/6. image: route-gateway:canary-2026-03-17

sam: monitoring checklist (summary):
- p95 latency (edge -> model): baseline 320ms, threshold 400ms
- 5xx errors / token-errors: threshold 0.5%
- request tail latencies (99th)
- model cost spike / token rate
- logs for fallback triggers (should see fallback:false)

devon: adding a small smoke watch: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/route -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.latency'` — will run every 30s for 20m.

li: if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 420ms for >2 consecutive 5m windows i will trigger rollback. rollback command added to runbook: `kubectl set image deploy/route-gateway route-gateway=route-gateway:stable --record`.

mira: blocker: one dataset item fails with new routing for long prompts (tokens>2048) — mitigations: pin that customer to stable via TargetedFlag in LD for now. i'll open a ticket.

sam: plan: hold at 5% for 30m. if green -> bump to 25% and monitor another 90m. everyone ack?

devon: ack

li: ack, watching

mira: ack, flagging customer pinning ticket (#INT-524)

sasha: tagging ops runbook section with the LD key and rollout timestamps. will hand off to li at 21:00 UTC for night watch.

li: i'll take handoff, will annotate any incidents in the thread and update the runbook. ping me @li if you need immediate rollback.

sam: thanks team :thumbsup: — i'll post a status update after the 30m check-in.
